messages.content: ترجم كل وحدة إنجليزية إلى العربية الفصحى بدقة واكتمال، مع حفظ المعنى والأسماء والإشارات الكتابية. لا تضف أسماء أو معلومات غير موجودة في النص، ولا تكتب ملاحظات أو شروحاً. أخرج JSON مطابقاً للمخطط فقط. يجب أن تكون chapter وverse عددين صحيحين بأرقام 0-9، وأن يكون text_ar ترجمة الوحدة وحدها.

{"chapter":1,"book_code":"2ES","verses":[{"chapter":1,"text":"I divided fruitful lands among you. I drove out the Canaanites, the Pherezites, and the Philistines before you. What more shall I do for you?” says the Lord.","verse":21},{"chapter":1,"text":"The Lord Almighty says, “When you were in the wilderness, at the bitter stream, being thirsty and blaspheming my name,","verse":22},{"chapter":1,"text":"I gave you not fire for your blasphemies, but threw a tree in the water, and made the river sweet.","verse":23},{"chapter":1,"text":"What shall I do to you, O Jacob? You, Judah, would not obey me. I will turn myself to other nations, and I will give my name to them, that they may keep my statutes.","verse":24},{"chapter":1,"text":"Since you have forsaken me, I also will forsake you. When you ask me to be merciful to you, I will have no mercy upon you.","verse":25},{"chapter":1,"text":"Whenever you call upon me, I will not hear you, for you have defiled your hands with blood, and your feet are swift to commit murder.","verse":26},{"chapter":1,"text":"It is not as though you have forsaken me, but your own selves,” says the Lord.","verse":27},{"chapter":1,"text":"The Lord Almighty says, “Haven’t I asked you as a father his sons, as a mother her daughters, and a nurse her young babies,","verse":28},{"chapter":1,"text":"that you would be my people, and I would be your God, that you would be my children, and I would be your father?","verse":29},{"chapter":1,"text":"I gathered you together, as a hen gathers her chicks under her wings. But now, what should I do to you? I will cast you out from my presence.","verse":30},{"chapter":1,"text":"When you offer burnt sacrifices to me, I will turn my face from you, for I have rejected your solemn feast days, your new moons, and your circumcisions of the flesh.","verse":31},{"chapter":1,"text":"I sent to you my servants the prophets, whom you have taken and slain, and torn their bodies in pieces, whose blood I will require from you,” says the Lord.","verse":32},{"chapter":1,"text":"The Lord Almighty says, “Your house is desolate. I will cast you out as the wind blows stubble.","verse":33},{"chapter":1,"text":"Your children won’t be fruitful, for they have neglected my commandment to you, and done that which is evil before me.","verse":34},{"chapter":1,"text":"I will give your houses to a people that will come, which not having heard of me yet believe me. Those to whom I have shown no signs will do what I have commanded.","verse":35},{"chapter":1,"text":"They have seen no prophets, yet they will remember their former condition.","verse":36},{"chapter":1,"text":"I call to witness the gratitude of the people who will come, whose little ones rejoice with gladness. Although they see me not with bodily eyes, yet in spirit they will believe what I say.”","verse":37},{"chapter":1,"text":"And now, father, behold with glory, and see the people that come from the east:","verse":38},{"chapter":1,"text":"to whom I will give for leaders, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, Oseas, Amos, and Micheas, Joel, Abdias, and Jonas,","verse":39},{"chapter":1,"text":"Nahum, and Abacuc, Sophonias, Aggaeus, Zachary, and Malachy, who is also called the Lord’s messenger.","verse":40}]}
